meta.title: Daniel Heinze — Software Developer
meta.description: Daniel Heinze, Software Developer from Poland. Works on Imunify Connect at CloudLinux and builds OnSide, a platform for EA FC Pro Clubs.

hero.title: I build software that businesses
hero.lead: Hi, I'm Daniel. At CloudLinux I work on Imunify Connect, a malware scanning API for WordPress and PHP plugins. After hours I build OnSide, my own platform for EA FC Pro Clubs.
hero.terminalLabel: Terminal: Daniel Heinze, Software Developer. Works on Imunify Connect at CloudLinux and on OnSide.

cloudlinux.title: Now at CloudLinux
cloudlinux.lead: CloudLinux makes CloudLinux OS and Imunify360 for web hosting. Its products run on more than 600,000 servers. I work on Imunify Connect.
cloudlinux.text: An API and PHP library that lets WordPress and PHP security plugins add Imunify's malware detection and cleanup under their own brand. Scans files by hash and, since the latest release, the WordPress database too.

work.title: Selected work
work.subtitle: My own product and client projects

onside.title: OnSide
onside.text: Everything for EA FC Pro Clubs in one place: self-service sign-up, teams, auto-generated fixtures, results verified through the EA API, public leagues, stats, rankings and achievements.

partio.title: Partio
partio.text: Fast product import and search over a database of millions of records, with file uploads for the team.

grupapwc.title: Grupa PWC
grupapwc.text: One panel for staff and machinery: worked hours, meetings and holidays.

scanbot.title: Scanbot for Filament
scanbot.text: A custom Filament component built on the Scanbot SDK. Users scan, process and manage documents right inside a Filament admin panel, using Scanbot's document detection, OCR and barcode recognition.

fivio.title: Fivio
fivio.text: Tells suppliers what products are in demand and runs an auction for the best offer.

webratings.title: Webratings
webratings.text: A Filament admin panel and REST API for product data: air purifiers, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, air conditioners and vacuums. Editors manage specs, custom fields, labels and shortcodes, and the API serves the data.

menago.title: Menago League
menago.note: Own project · EA FC career-mode league

about.title: About
body: Five years of PHP, most of them in web hosting. First WHMCS modules at ModulesGarden, now security products at CloudLinux, the company behind CloudLinux OS and Imunify360.
Next to that I build Laravel apps for clients and my own platform, OnSide. I like simple, reliable code and admin panels that are fast to work with.

cloudlinux.text: Imunify Connect: malware scanning API and PHP library for WordPress and PHP plugin developers.

freelance.text: Laravel apps and admin panels for clients.

modulesgarden.text: WHMCS modules for hosting automation: cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin, WordPress Manager.

jomafive.text: A web app for organising events and tournaments for kids' football.
